tasks.label: Run core tests (fast, no Minecraft)
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-21'; & "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\javac.exe" -d build/coretest -encoding UTF-8 (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src/main/java -Filter *.java | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'client|data|ProgressionParser|BossStore' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) src/test/java/minerefinehud/CoreTests.java; & "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin\java.exe" -cp build/coretest minerefinehud.CoreTests
